# Azimlib visual identity

The wordmark and 2048-pixel globe are the preferred assets for project
presentations. The 110-pixel and 32-pixel icons have thicker grids and arrows
for small displays; they are distinct compositions, not simple reductions.

| Asset | Intended use |
| --- | --- |
| [Wordmark](azimlib-wordmark.png) | README and horizontal presentations |
| [2048-pixel globe](azimlib-logo-2048.png) | Large presentations and artwork |
| [110-pixel icon](azimlib-logo-110.png) | Compact project cards |
| [32-pixel icon](azimlib-logo-32.png) | Small icons |

All PNGs retain their original transparent backgrounds. The source images are
preserved byte for byte, with sizes and hashes in [the manifest](manifest.json).
Original visual compositions: Copyright (c) 2026 Kernerian, BSD-3-Clause.
The globe geometry uses Natural Earth public-domain data, rendered by Azimlib.
The underlying data remains governed by its own terms; see
[third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md).
No Matplotlib logo, icon, artwork or implementation is included.
